text.div: Patient Document generated by Health Intersections Patient Health Document Generator

I'm a grandmother of three beautiful grandchildren and mother of four adult children. I was recently diagnosed with stage 2 breast cancer, which has been devastating news for our family. I also have type 2 diabetes and early kidney problems. I had stage 4 colon cancer 8 years ago and survived after major surgery. I'm determined to beat this cancer too, but I'm worried about how the treatment will affect my diabetes and kidneys. My family is my everything - I need to be here for my grandchildren.

Patient's Goals

  • Successfully treat breast cancer while managing diabetes
  • Maintain kidney function during cancer treatment
  • Stay involved in grandchildren's lives throughout treatment
